國家之養士百四十年於此矣
高皇帝始宅金陵戎馬未息而
興學設科惓惓以求賢才成天
===
下之治為務一時
武烈文謨巍然煥然照映今古
雖曰
帝之神聖而諸賢之助亦多矣
豐芑之詒於今益盛
聖子神孫所以翕受敷施以光
高帝之業垂無疆之休誠不可謂
punctuated:
應天府郷試錄後序

正德二年，應天府郷試錄成，臣清以職事當序其後，廼拜稽首而言曰：「惟我國家之養士，百四十年於此矣。高皇帝始宅金陵，戎馬未息，而興學設科，惓惓以求賢才、成天下之治為務。一時武烈文謨，巍然煥然，照映今古。雖曰帝之神聖，而諸賢之助亦多矣。豐芑之詒，於今益盛。聖子神孫所以翕受敷施，以光高帝之業，垂無疆之休，誠不可謂
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination

In the second year of Zhengde (1507), the Record of the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination was completed. Your servant Qing, whose official duties required him to provide its postface, thereupon bowed and touched his forehead to the ground, saying:

“Our dynasty has nurtured scholars for one hundred and forty years now. When Emperor Gao first established his seat at Jinling, warfare had not yet ceased, yet he founded schools and instituted examinations, diligently making it his task to seek worthy talent and bring orderly government to all under Heaven. The military achievements and civil designs of that age were lofty and resplendent, illuminating past and present alike. Though these may be attributed to the Emperor’s sagacity, the assistance of the many worthy men was also considerable.

“The legacy of nurturing talent for posterity—evoked by the luxuriant millet—has grown still more flourishing today. The sagely sons and divine grandsons have drawn upon it, gathering talent and extending their beneficence, to glorify Emperor Gao’s achievements and bequeath boundless blessings; truly, it cannot be said …

title: 正德二年應天府鄉試錄
text:
無所自也夫人材惟其盛則
其擇之也難精而其取之每
患於不能盡譬則沙中之金
千百一二則光彩照耀易以
掇拾璚林大盈珎貝溢目應
接不暇則挂一漏萬亦埶使
然也臣嘗聞之前輩之司文
===
衡者則已病其然矣而臣生
長
畿甸蓋四舉於是而後乃得之
故信其難為尤真乃今奉
命而来以校文為職凡前日之
所謂盛者今皆得以接于目
前而惟吾之所擇而前輩之

接不暇則挂一漏萬亦埶使
然也〔臣〕嘗聞之前輩之司文
衡者則已病其然矣而〔臣〕生
===
長
纖向盖四舉於是而後乃得之
故信其難為尤真乃今奉
命而来以校文為職凡前日之
所謂盛者今皆得以接于目
前而惟吾之所擇而前輩之
punctuated: 無所自也。夫人材惟其盛，則其擇之也難精，而其取之每患於不能盡。譬則沙中之金，千百一二，則光彩照耀，易以掇拾；璚林大盈，珎貝溢目，應接不暇，則挂一漏萬，亦埶使然也。臣嘗聞之前輩之司文衡者，則已病其然矣。而臣生長畿甸，蓋四舉於是而後乃得之，故信其難為尤真。乃今奉命而来，以校文為職，凡前日之所謂盛者，今皆得以接于目前，而惟吾之所擇，而前輩之
translation_en:
…without a source. When talented men are abundant, it is difficult to select them with precision, and in recruiting them one constantly fears being unable to include them all. Consider gold amid sand: if there are only one or two pieces among hundreds or thousands of grains, their brilliance shines forth, and they are easy to pick out. But in the Qionglin and Daying treasuries, precious objects and shells fill the eye; there is scarcely time to take them all in. To mention one while overlooking ten thousand is then an inevitable consequence of the circumstances. Your servant has heard this from predecessors charged with weighing literary merit: they already regarded this as a difficulty.

Your servant grew up in the metropolitan region and took the examination here four times before finally succeeding. Thus I know its difficulty with particular certainty. Now I have come under imperial command, charged with evaluating examination essays. All the abundance of talent spoken of in earlier days is now before my eyes, awaiting my selection; and what my predecessors…

title: 正德二年應天府鄉試錄
text:
所以為難者亦無所辭焉蓋
喜幸之心不能勝戰兢之念
而披閱之勤不足以釋瘝曠
之憂至於所謂公無私者則
臣之分內而在所不論也今
撤棘有期錄既成矣二旬之
間搜珠于淵採玉於山亦自
===
竭其力矣而臣之心猶未敢
以釋然者
高皇帝之作人材始基於
皇上即位求賢輟儒臣以司校理
亦首及於是是固
望其率先四方羅真才以為
新政助也而

喜幸之心不能勝戰兢之念
而披閱之勤不足以釋瘝曠
之憂至於所謂公無私者則
臣之分内而在所不論也今
撤棘有期錄既成矣二旬之
間搜珠于淵採玉於山亦自
竭其力矣而臣之心猶未敢
===
以釋然者

皇上即位求賢輟儒臣以司校理
亦首及於是是固
望其率先四方羅真才以為
新政助也而
punctuated: 所以為難者，亦無所辭焉。蓋喜幸之心不能勝戰兢之念，而披閱之勤不足以釋瘝曠之憂。至於所謂公無私者，則臣之分內，而在所不論也。今撤棘有期，錄既成矣。二旬之間，搜珠于淵，採玉於山，亦自竭其力矣。而臣之心猶未敢以釋然者，高皇帝之作人材始基於，皇上即位，求賢，輟儒臣以司校理，亦首及於是。是固望其率先四方，羅真才以為新政助也。而
translation_en:
…nor can I decline what my predecessors found so difficult. Indeed, my joy and good fortune cannot overcome my trembling apprehension, and my diligence in reading the papers does not suffice to dispel my anxiety over neglecting my duties. As for being impartial and free of private interests, that is simply my duty as your servant and requires no discussion here. Now the date for removing the thorn barrier of the examination compound is set, and the record has been completed. During these twenty days, searching for pearls in the depths and gathering jade in the mountains, I too have exhausted my strength.

Yet my heart still dares not rest at ease. Emperor Gao’s cultivation of talent first had its foundation in [?]. Upon ascending the throne, Your Majesty sought worthy men and detached scholarly officials to oversee the assessment of examination papers, likewise turning first to this place. Surely the expectation is that it should take the lead throughout the realm, gathering true talent to assist the governance of the new reign. And…

title: 正德二年應天府鄉試錄
text:
南畿之士其文章又若是其盛
也則臣安敢謂所取之必得
而遺珎墜寶果無一二於山
海之間乎雖然登名是錄者
百三十有五人亦不謂之少
矣臣又安敢謂無奇傑之才
數人焉出其間以應
===
上之求者顧嘗聞之文之盛者實
之衰而天下之事類非一於
文而無實者之所能辦諸生
之文盛矣聖賢經世宰物之
學槩於此具焉舉而措之成
天下之治不難也其信皆所
得乎故臣序錄之終篇而三

百三十有五人亦不謂之少
矣〔臣〕又安敢謂無奇傑之才

===

之衰而天下之事類非一於
文而無實者之所能辦諸生
之文盛矣聖賢經世宰物之
學槩於此具焉舉而措之成
天下之治不難也其信皆所
得乎故〔臣〕序錄之終篇而三
punctuated: 南畿之士，其文章又若是其盛也，則臣安敢謂所取之必得，而遺珎墜寶果無一二於山海之間乎？雖然，登名是錄者百三十有五人，亦不謂之少矣。臣又安敢謂無奇傑之才數人焉，出其間以應上之求者？顧嘗聞之，文之盛者，實之衰，而天下之事，類非一於文而無實者之所能辦。諸生之文盛矣，聖賢經世宰物之學，槩於此具焉。舉而措之，成天下之治，不難也。其信皆所得乎？故臣序錄之終篇而三
translation_en:
…The writings of the scholars of the Southern Metropolitan Region are so flourishing: how, then, dare your servant claim that those selected must all be worthy, and that among the mountains and seas there truly remain no overlooked pearls or lost treasures? Nevertheless, the names entered in this record number one hundred and thirty-five, which cannot be called few. How, moreover, dare your servant claim that there are not among them several men of extraordinary talent who will emerge to answer His Majesty’s call?

Yet I have heard that flourishing literary accomplishment accompanies declining substance, and that the affairs of the world generally cannot be managed by those devoted solely to literary accomplishment without substance. Your writings, gentlemen, are flourishing indeed. The learning of the sages and worthies concerning the ordering of the world and the governance of all things is broadly embodied here. To take it up and put it into practice, bringing good government to the realm, would not be difficult. But have you truly made all this learning your own? Thus, as your servant brings this preface to the examination record to its close, I thrice…

title: 正德二年應天府鄉試錄
text:
致意焉諸生者尚勉於其實
而無徒以文為則有司其有
望焉矣塲屋執事諸氏名臣
珪之首序詳之茲不複
翰林院侍讀顧清謹序
alt_text:
致意焉諸生者尚勉於其實
而無徒以文為則有司其有
望焉矣場屋執事諸氏名臣
珪之首序詳之茲不復
翰林院侍讀顧清謹序
punctuated:
致意焉。諸生者尚勉於其實，而無徒以文為則，有司其有望焉矣。塲屋執事諸氏名，臣珪之首序詳之，茲不複。
翰林院侍讀顧清謹序。
translation_en:
…stress this point. You candidates should strive for substantive learning and not merely take literary composition as your standard; then the responsible officials may have grounds for hope. The names of those serving in the examination compound are detailed in the opening preface by your servant Gui and are not repeated here.
Preface respectfully written by Gu Qing, Reader-in-Waiting of the Hanlin Academy.
